latest_release.name: v8.4.212 - `ultralytics 8.4.212` Read Korean, Cyrillic, Arabic and other scripts with OCR (#27167)
latest_release.body:
## 🌟 Summary
**Ultralytics 8.4.212 expands OCR to more writing systems and improves Platform discovery, data import, training reliability, and inference compatibility.**

## 📊 Key Changes
- 🌍 **OCR supports more languages and scripts.** Choose a PP-OCRv5 model to recognize Korean, Cyrillic, Arabic, Devanagari, Thai, Greek, Tamil, or Telugu text. These models run through ONNX Runtime, without requiring PaddlePaddle or PaddleOCR. For example:
  ```python
  ocr = solutions.OCR(recognizer="korean_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec")
  result = ocr(im0)
  ```
  Select the model for the text you expect; OCR does not automatically identify or switch languages. Hebrew is not included in the new models.
- 🔎 **Platform Explore adds a Models tab.** Search public models by what they detect, browse results, and try or clone models. The Platform docs also cover direct imports from hosted Label Studio, including supported detection, oriented-box, segmentation, and classification projects.
- 🧰 **Training and evaluation are more dependable.** Fixes prevent distributed training from hanging when canceled, restore deterministic training for certain tasks on older macOS MPS setups, and include mask, pose, and semantic pixel-accuracy details in exported validation summaries.
- ⚡ **Inference and export fixes improve compatibility and efficiency.** ONNX Runtime is better matched to CUDA 12 PyTorch installs and uses more suitable CPU thread limits; TensorRT checks recognize installations in NVIDIA containers and JetPack. MNN inputs, YOLOE tracking with ReID, and Edge TPU pose keypoints also receive fixes.
- 🛡️ **Data handling is safer and more efficient.** Detection crop saving avoids unnecessary full-image copies; segmentation-mask conversion now rejects filename collisions before overwriting labels; source lists consistently use UTF-8.
- 📚 **Documentation is refreshed.** Guides reflect current Platform features, and outdated DeepSparse documentation is removed because the project has reached end of life.

## 🎯 Purpose & Impact
- People working with multilingual images can use a suitable OCR recognizer for scripts that the default PP-OCRv6 model does not cover.
- Platform users can more easily find relevant public models and bring supported hosted Label Studio projects into their workflow.
- Training, validation exports, and deployment should behave more reliably across distributed setups and a wider range of hardware and software versions.
- Safer file handling and reduced image copying help prevent accidental data loss and avoid unnecessary work.

## What's Changed
* Platform docs: Explore Models tab, HEIC previews in Predict, Recent Activity dataset status by @pderrenger in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27160
* Platform docs: current VLM leaderboard picks, Explore model deploy and ranking wording, Predict screenshots without Ask AI by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27163
* Fix DDP hang when Platform cancels training mid-epoch by @artest08 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27161
* Fix deterministic semantic, depth and segment training on MPS with torch<2.3 by @raimbekovm in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27159
* Divide the dataloader worker cap by the GPUs of the run by @raimbekovm in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27162
* Update YouTube video link in `isolating-segmentation-objects` docs by @RizwanMunawar in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27165
* Remove neural magic deepsparse docs pages after end of life by @raimbekovm in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27169
* Avoid full-frame copies when saving detection crops by @aswanth-07 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27170
* Fix YOLOE tracking with native ReID features by @raimbekovm in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27171
* Read source manifests as UTF-8 by @mh-masum6875 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27172
* Prevent mask convers
